g.text: Tune with Automatic: value lists, objective, requirements
plan the grid: Cartesian product of the value lists (at most 64), pinned values kept, REAL values rounded
check the trial count and the scan and wall budgets; each trial's settings and model route
[Every planned trial, until the grid ends or a stop (cancel, budget, program revision change, run failure)]
journal the trial's isolated run before its start
start the trial: its values as parameter overrides; the selected model as simulation_override
isolated simulation with complete resets: the project's actual ST on the selected model, with the same initial values, plant state, events, time points and seed
recorded run: samples and constraint status
bounds are checked before ranking; a violation or missing evidence never qualifies; J = trapezoidal ISE after the settling deadline
select the smallest J among the qualifying trials; equal J: the first listed
keep the candidate (searchCandidate, study Tune section) when the search completed, or ran out of budget with a qualifying trial; a cancelled, changed or failed search keeps nothing
final update: status, selected trial, every trial (attempted, bounds, J), stages
The runtime's search job (control.search.*, E8.5) runs against the project's own
simulation, not the selected model; Control Studio does not call it.
A search never runs against the selected physical runtime (C5).
